newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Tanakorn Finance hits limit low.
newsitem.headline: Thai Tanakorn Finance hits limit low.

text.p: Large blocks of Thai Tanakorn Finance Plc shares plunged to a 10 percent limit low on Thursday morning, making it the market's top loser, brokers said.

Thai Tanakorn declined 4.50 baht to 40.50 shortly after opening and remained there by lunch time. Some 196,800 of its shares worth eight million baht were traded mostly at the daily floor price by noon.
Thai Tanakorn officials were not immediately available for comment.
A broker said while small finance firms failed to perform during the morning session, the market saw support for large capitalised finance issues.

Thai Tanakorn had posted volatile price movement earlier this year. In April when the market was bearish, the stock rallied 21 percent in one week, prompting the Stock Exchange of Thailand to seek explanation from the company.

According to stock exchange statistics earlier this year, 17.76 percent of Thai Tanakorn shares was held by Thai Military Bank Plc, 0.76 percent by prominent Thai investor Song Watcharasriroj, 3.50 percent by Siroj Wongsirojakul, and 3.30 percent by Niphon Kosaipolkul.
